governance.intro: These settings apply to every new case of this type. Cases already filed keep the settings they were filed under.

governance.codePermanent: Can't be changed after it's saved.
governance.regulatoryExample: e.g. Notify the regulator within 72 hours
governance.regulatoryHint: A reminder for handlers. Nobody is notified automatically.
governance.anonymousHint: Reporters may file without giving their identity.

voice.title: Voice Questions
voice.intro: What the voice agent finds out on every call, in order. It asks conversationally, in the caller's own language — changes apply from the next call.
voice.shortIntro: What the AI agent finds out on every call.
voice.seoDescription: Choose what the AI agent finds out on every reporting call.
voice.loadFailed: The question set could not be loaded.
voice.saveFailed: The question set could not be saved.
voice.fixFirst: Fix the highlighted questions before saving.
voice.saved: Saved — the next call uses these questions.
voice.resetTitle: Discard your questions and use the defaults
voice.resetConfirmBody: Your questions will be discarded and the defaults restored. Reports already submitted keep the answers they were collected with.
voice.defaultsBody: Edit them and save to make them yours. Nothing here is live for your organization until you do.
voice.needAttentionBody: Nothing is saved until every question is valid — saving replaces the whole list at once.
voice.unsaved: Unsaved changes · they apply from the next call
voice.end: The report is filed and the caller gets their tracking details.

opening.title: Opening remark
opening.afterGreeting: Said after the greeting from Voice Profile
opening.label: What the agent says after its greeting
opening.placeholder: Leave blank for the default opening
opening.hint: The greeting itself is set on the Voice Profile page. Leave this blank and the agent opens in its own words.

evidence.title: Ask for supporting files
evidence.on: The agent invites photos, documents or recordings.
evidence.off: The agent won't bring it up; callers can still upload.

empty.title: No questions
empty.body: This is allowed — the agent simply has a free-form conversation and writes up whatever the caller tells it. Add a question to steer it.

editor.mustDiffer: Options must be different from each other.
editor.whatHint: Write it as something to find out, not a form prompt — the agent phrases the question itself, in the caller's language.
editor.kindHint: This doesn't change how the agent asks — only how the answer is stored, so reports can be filtered and charted by it.
editor.optionsHint: Keep them short and distinct — the agent reads them out.
editor.requiredOn: The caller must answer it, or say they would rather not.
editor.requiredOff: The agent asks, but the caller can skip it.
editor.guidancePlaceholder: How the agent should probe, e.g. an estimate is fine.

text.label: Text
text.hint: Free-form answer in the caller's own words
